resources.string: DashBuddy assists delivery drivers by reading enabled delivery apps\' screens and speaking offers while you drive. Recognition and calculations run on your phone. Accept and Decline require your tap in DashBuddy; automated actions need separate grants. Optional Screen events identifies other apps in front. Recognized screens showing your banking, payment or ID details, and document-capture screens, are blocked before parsing or storage. Filters can miss unrecognized screens in debug captures. Optional screenshots save the whole display. History and settings may enter Android backup; gallery apps may sync screenshots. Debug capture uploads require developer toggles.
DashBuddy does not sell your data. Android backup and network features can send data off this phone.
DashBuddy reads offers aloud while you drive. Accept and Decline require your tap; automated actions need your permission.

Android Accessibility reads enabled delivery apps. Optional Screen events identifies other apps in front. Recognized screens showing your banking, payment or ID details, and document-capture screens, are blocked before parsing or storage. Recognition and calculations run on-device; recognized customer names and addresses are stored as hashes. Debug captures may retain details the filters miss.\n\nGas-price refresh is off by default on new installs; an existing setting is kept. Android\'s geocoder may send coordinates to its provider; EIA receives a regional fuel-price request. Tap the bubble\'s gas price for manual mode to stop automatic refreshes. Setup sends vehicle selections to EPA for MPG. Neither lookup sends an account or install ID. The manual MPG search opens Google with your vehicle query. Debug census uploads need developer opt-in; trusted capture sharing can send customer text to the configured server\'s operator. Release builds do neither. Optional screenshots save the whole display to Pictures/DashBuddy; gallery sync may copy them. Android may back up history and settings to your Google account or transfer them to another phone; consent records are excluded. History, settings and debug captures last until cleared or uninstalled; Android may restore history and settings from backup. Logs rotate; screenshots and exports remain until deleted. See PRIVACY.md.
Read offers and tip updates from enabled delivery apps\' notifications.

Android\'s notification listener reads enabled delivery apps only. Other apps\' notifications are dropped before reading. Recognized events are stored in your history; Android backup may copy it. Debug captures can retain notification text. Debug census sharing is off by default; release builds cannot upload it.
Track dash miles to estimate earnings after gas and wear.

The odometer samples GPS during a dash and stops when it ends, reducing battery use and location collection. Gas-price refresh can read your last location outside a dash and send coordinates to Android\'s geocoding provider. Refresh is off by default on new installs; an existing setting is kept. Tap the bubble\'s gas price for manual mode to stop automatic refreshes. Recorded miles remain in history and may enter Android backup.

Delivery-app rules define these actions. Automated actions stay off until you allow each one. Choose Allow or Don\'t allow for each, or Not now to decide later. Direct Accept and Decline presses are your own actions. Decision receipts with their time, app version and privacy revision stay on this phone; backup and device transfer exclude them. The app log also records each grant or revocation; it leaves the phone only in a bug report you export. Change them under Settings → Data & Privacy → Automation & Consent.
